name: wayfinder-starmap
description: /maps: your wayfinder maps (GitHub or Forgejo issues) as an interactive star map in a pane -- frontier, claims, blockers, fog and lint; drag, zoom, click a star to read its ticket, Assign one to your session

repo.title: Repository
repo.description: The owner/repo whose issues hold your wayfinder maps (issues labelled wayfinder:map)

source.title: Tracker
source.description: github: read through the gh CLI. forgejo: read through Forge-Tools' hub-api

ghCommand.title: gh command
ghCommand.description: The GitHub CLI to run, signed in with `gh auth login`

fontFile.title: Label font file
fontFile.description: A font for the star map's labels: the JSON file font-gen.html saves (any font, read as pixels). Empty: the built-in Replace The Sun

hubApiCommand.title: hub-api command
hubApiCommand.description: Forge-Tools' hub-api, for a Forgejo tracker
